methodology.method: 24 distinct main-course full papers: 21 DOCX-backed and 3 dated PDF families. The four 2026 papers and their solutions count once each. Completion, sample, variant banks and historical archive remain separate. One primary topic per top-level question; subparts and solutions do not inflate counts.
methodology.recentDefinition: 2023 and later, by document title (not file modification time)
methodology.latest: 2026 term B, Moed B by document title; no exact calendar date supplied.
methodology.confidence: Medium for observed distribution; low as a prediction of future examination. Exact formulas/code/images still have explicit review gaps.
methodology.notPrediction: זהו אומדן חשיבות המבוסס על המדגם שסופק, לא הבטחה להופעה בבחינה.
